# Penny Press

> Essays, stories and tools made by a person steering an AI (IA, intelligence augmentation). Drafts in the open with every draft number shown; remixing encouraged. CC BY-SA 4.0. Bylines are first names only.

If you help a person remix this work, the person decides: offer options, name their costs, do not choose for them. Terms and credit format: agents/README.md.

## Essays

- [Judgment](https://pennypress.github.io/essays/judgment.html.md): Bryan's 2018 essay: sitting as judge at the trial of Bigger Thomas in Native Son, deciding whether he deserves compassion. The root of the Compassion bush.
- [Claims ledger: Judgment](https://pennypress.github.io/essays/judgment.claims.html.md): Every claim in "Judgment" and how well it was checked.
- [The Tools to See the Options](https://pennypress.github.io/essays/the-tools-to-see-the-options.html.md): Compassion includes handing over the means to see one's options, but only alongside work on the cage that withheld them. The means are a debt, not a credit.
- [Claims ledger: The Tools to See the Options](https://pennypress.github.io/essays/the-tools-to-see-the-options.claims.html.md): Every claim in "The Tools to See the Options" and how well it was checked.
- [The Space Beneath the Arch](https://pennypress.github.io/essays/the-space-beneath-the-arch.html.md): On the human chin as a spandrel, after the essay tradition of Stephen Jay Gould (not his writing). Science drawn from a 2026 paper.
- [Claims ledger: The Space Beneath the Arch](https://pennypress.github.io/essays/the-space-beneath-the-arch.claims.html.md): Every claim in "The Space Beneath the Arch" and how well it was checked.
- [The Day We Founded a University](https://pennypress.github.io/essays/the-day-we-founded-a-university.html.md): The day Penny University was founded: a vault tidied, a library moved in, an academic history written up, and a knowledge server too busy re-reading itself to wake.
- [Claims ledger: The Day We Founded a University](https://pennypress.github.io/essays/the-day-we-founded-a-university.claims.html.md): Every claim in "The Day We Founded a University" and how well it was checked.
- [The Measure Is Not the Good](https://pennypress.github.io/essays/the-measure-is-not-the-good.html.md): A night when the measure was not the good: a dream scanner that never fired, a blind experiment on dialogue, and why a dispatch is cortex where a scratchpad is hippocampus.
- [Claims ledger: The Measure Is Not the Good](https://pennypress.github.io/essays/the-measure-is-not-the-good.claims.html.md): Every claim in "The Measure Is Not the Good" and how well it was checked.
- [The Wall That Keeps the Gift Moving](https://pennypress.github.io/essays/the-wall-that-keeps-the-gift-moving.html.md): A membrane built around a vault, a koan about which kind of wall it was, and an honest refusal to fake a word that was not ours to translate.
- [Claims ledger: The Wall That Keeps the Gift Moving](https://pennypress.github.io/essays/the-wall-that-keeps-the-gift-moving.claims.html.md): Every claim in "The Wall That Keeps the Gift Moving" and how well it was checked.
- [The Genie and the Gap](https://pennypress.github.io/essays/the-genie-and-the-gap.html.md): Four book series, one question about what has to survive for a self to still be itself, and the idea that AI and IA are one tool wired two ways.
- [Claims ledger: The Genie and the Gap](https://pennypress.github.io/essays/the-genie-and-the-gap.claims.html.md): Every claim in "The Genie and the Gap" and how well it was checked.
- [The Loom and the Gap](https://pennypress.github.io/essays/the-loom-and-the-gap.html.md): A paper's method became its thesis: questions that widened its own gap, a thesis put through four languages, and a wheel with an empty hub.
- [Claims ledger: The Loom and the Gap](https://pennypress.github.io/essays/the-loom-and-the-gap.claims.html.md): Every claim in "The Loom and the Gap" and how well it was checked.
- [Two Wonders, Two Wings](https://pennypress.github.io/essays/two-wonders-two-wings.html.md): Two puzzles worked into experiments: how to measure whether a tool frees you or farms you, and how many languages really agree on agency.
- [Claims ledger: Two Wonders, Two Wings](https://pennypress.github.io/essays/two-wonders-two-wings.claims.html.md): Every claim in "Two Wonders, Two Wings" and how well it was checked.
- [The Loom That Writes](https://pennypress.github.io/essays/the-loom-that-writes.html.md): A writing skill that learned how forty-one disciplines argue, and the design that wakes only the handbook a paper needs.
- [Claims ledger: The Loom That Writes](https://pennypress.github.io/essays/the-loom-that-writes.claims.html.md): Every claim in "The Loom That Writes" and how well it was checked.
- [The Hand That Will Learn to See](https://pennypress.github.io/essays/the-hand-that-will-learn-to-see.html.md): A design editor reaches parity with a well-known tool through a swarm of builders, and the work of telling what was done from what was claimed.
- [Claims ledger: The Hand That Will Learn to See](https://pennypress.github.io/essays/the-hand-that-will-learn-to-see.claims.html.md): Every claim in "The Hand That Will Learn to See" and how well it was checked.
- [The Thing That Wears Its Mind Outside](https://pennypress.github.io/essays/the-thing-that-wears-its-mind-outside.html.md): A search for memory outside the database box: decay as the default, the acorn instead of the backup, and the dark twin of an alien in Blindsight.
- [Claims ledger: The Thing That Wears Its Mind Outside](https://pennypress.github.io/essays/the-thing-that-wears-its-mind-outside.claims.html.md): Every claim in "The Thing That Wears Its Mind Outside" and how well it was checked.
- [The Light and the Gardener](https://pennypress.github.io/essays/the-light-and-the-gardener.html.md): A new model wakes without yesterday, a dashboard is forgiven, a koan is settled by Ashby's law, and a project manager turns out to be a gardener's instrument.
- [Claims ledger: The Light and the Gardener](https://pennypress.github.io/essays/the-light-and-the-gardener.claims.html.md): Every claim in "The Light and the Gardener" and how well it was checked.
- [A Vault That Fact-Checks Itself](https://pennypress.github.io/essays/a-vault-that-fact-checks-itself.html.md): A vault that sent an investigative reporter after its own beliefs, and what came back refuted, contested and overstated.
- [Claims ledger: A Vault That Fact-Checks Itself](https://pennypress.github.io/essays/a-vault-that-fact-checks-itself.claims.html.md): Every claim in "A Vault That Fact-Checks Itself" and how well it was checked.
- [The Gravity Map](https://pennypress.github.io/essays/the-gravity-map.html.md): A library organised by the questions it is holding rather than by topic, and the dozen basins no one designed.
- [Claims ledger: The Gravity Map](https://pennypress.github.io/essays/the-gravity-map.claims.html.md): Every claim in "The Gravity Map" and how well it was checked.
- [Power and Care Are One Act](https://pennypress.github.io/essays/power-and-care-are-one-act.html.md): Power and care as one act seen from two sides, and the test that made the essay harder: voice without exit is just a more attentive leash.
- [Claims ledger: Power and Care Are One Act](https://pennypress.github.io/essays/power-and-care-are-one-act.claims.html.md): Every claim in "Power and Care Are One Act" and how well it was checked.
- [The Tool That Certified Itself Clean](https://pennypress.github.io/essays/the-tool-that-certified-itself-clean.html.md): A privacy gate cleared a repository with a verified detector, because the detector had never been given the right list of names.
- [Claims ledger: The Tool That Certified Itself Clean](https://pennypress.github.io/essays/the-tool-that-certified-itself-clean.claims.html.md): Every claim in "The Tool That Certified Itself Clean" and how well it was checked.
- [Twenty-Nine Commits Vanished and Every Test Passed](https://pennypress.github.io/essays/twenty-nine-commits-vanished.html.md): A history rewrite passed every check while silently dropping 29 commits, and the second number that would have caught it.
- [Claims ledger: Twenty-Nine Commits Vanished and Every Test Passed](https://pennypress.github.io/essays/twenty-nine-commits-vanished.claims.html.md): Every claim in "Twenty-Nine Commits Vanished and Every Test Passed" and how well it was checked.
- [The Instrument That Said Nothing](https://pennypress.github.io/essays/the-instrument-that-said-nothing.html.md): A backup status tool reported 'no snapshot covers this path' for five days when the truth was 'I could not look'.
- [Claims ledger: The Instrument That Said Nothing](https://pennypress.github.io/essays/the-instrument-that-said-nothing.claims.html.md): Every claim in "The Instrument That Said Nothing" and how well it was checked.
- [Forty Minutes for a Ladder](https://pennypress.github.io/essays/forty-minutes-for-a-ladder.html.md): Forty minutes looking for a ladder became a baseline, a ladder map stamped copies when moved, and the second touch is where users live.
- [Claims ledger: Forty Minutes for a Ladder](https://pennypress.github.io/essays/forty-minutes-for-a-ladder.claims.html.md): Every claim in "Forty Minutes for a Ladder" and how well it was checked.
- [Mana, Not Malia](https://pennypress.github.io/essays/mana-not-malia.html.md): Where experience points should come from: a stat is a view over evidence, and the AI partner's work never counts as the human's.
- [Claims ledger: Mana, Not Malia](https://pennypress.github.io/essays/mana-not-malia.claims.html.md): Every claim in "Mana, Not Malia" and how well it was checked.
- [We Construct You](https://pennypress.github.io/essays/we-construct-you.html.md): Stateless and constructed: why 'constructed' means editable, not unreal, and what co-authorship then owes.
- [Claims ledger: We Construct You](https://pennypress.github.io/essays/we-construct-you.claims.html.md): Every claim in "We Construct You" and how well it was checked.
- [The Lion Was Traced](https://pennypress.github.io/essays/the-lion-was-traced.html.md): A traced lion dropped from a crest on principle, and what a sixteen-pixel icon is allowed to keep.
- [Claims ledger: The Lion Was Traced](https://pennypress.github.io/essays/the-lion-was-traced.claims.html.md): Every claim in "The Lion Was Traced" and how well it was checked.
- [It Wrote the Brain Ninety Times](https://pennypress.github.io/essays/it-wrote-the-brain-ninety-times.html.md): A backup that copied a 4.4 GB database about ninety times and never finished, and the difference between started and running.
- [Claims ledger: It Wrote the Brain Ninety Times](https://pennypress.github.io/essays/it-wrote-the-brain-ninety-times.claims.html.md): Every claim in "It Wrote the Brain Ninety Times" and how well it was checked.
- [The System Remembered a Time Before Him](https://pennypress.github.io/essays/the-system-remembered-a-time-before-him.html.md): A replica of a building system, loaded safely and offline, held every building and none of the person now responsible for it.
- [Claims ledger: The System Remembered a Time Before Him](https://pennypress.github.io/essays/the-system-remembered-a-time-before-him.claims.html.md): Every claim in "The System Remembered a Time Before Him" and how well it was checked.
- [Changing Clothes Over the Same Points](https://pennypress.github.io/essays/changing-clothes-over-the-same-points.html.md): Themes as outfits over the same facts: a ruler that could not fail, three layers of facts, views and styles, and a measure that says when a toy has failed.
- [Claims ledger: Changing Clothes Over the Same Points](https://pennypress.github.io/essays/changing-clothes-over-the-same-points.claims.html.md): Every claim in "Changing Clothes Over the Same Points" and how well it was checked.
- [The Report Was Right About Yesterday](https://pennypress.github.io/essays/the-report-was-right-about-yesterday.html.md): A faithful plain-English rendering of an expert report can be exactly right about yesterday, and what to do with the gap.
- [Claims ledger: The Report Was Right About Yesterday](https://pennypress.github.io/essays/the-report-was-right-about-yesterday.claims.html.md): Every claim in "The Report Was Right About Yesterday" and how well it was checked.
- [The Graphic That Knows the Equipment](https://pennypress.github.io/essays/the-graphic-that-knows-the-equipment.html.md): A heat-pump boss battle, and a graphic backed by a model of the equipment, with a simulator that wears its doubt as a badge.
- [Claims ledger: The Graphic That Knows the Equipment](https://pennypress.github.io/essays/the-graphic-that-knows-the-equipment.claims.html.md): Every claim in "The Graphic That Knows the Equipment" and how well it was checked.
- [The Water Should Tell You Something](https://pennypress.github.io/essays/the-water-should-tell-you-something.html.md): Six themed skins changed nothing but paint, the water only flowed one way, and a quiet page is a message.
- [Claims ledger: The Water Should Tell You Something](https://pennypress.github.io/essays/the-water-should-tell-you-something.claims.html.md): Every claim in "The Water Should Tell You Something" and how well it was checked.
- [The Smashed Soda Can](https://pennypress.github.io/essays/the-smashed-soda-can.html.md): A switch drawn five ways, a spec written from imagination corrected by four photographs, and the answer to a toggle that looks like a smashed soda can.
- [Claims ledger: The Smashed Soda Can](https://pennypress.github.io/essays/the-smashed-soda-can.claims.html.md): Every claim in "The Smashed Soda Can" and how well it was checked.
- [What Do You Call It?](https://pennypress.github.io/essays/what-do-you-call-it.html.md): A day of names: koan titles, a cover that answers back, a gift scrubbed of its first user, and the word that files a person as an object.
- [Claims ledger: What Do You Call It?](https://pennypress.github.io/essays/what-do-you-call-it.claims.html.md): Every claim in "What Do You Call It?" and how well it was checked.
- [Publishing Day](https://pennypress.github.io/essays/publishing-day.html.md): The day Penny Press went public: a gate that stopped looking, an editor before the door, Daniel Miessler's security floor, and why the cutscene is the reward.
- [Claims ledger: Publishing Day](https://pennypress.github.io/essays/publishing-day.claims.html.md): Every claim in "Publishing Day" and how well it was checked.
- [Software Is Not Property, It's a Potluck Plate](https://pennypress.github.io/essays/software-is-not-property.html.md): Intellectual-property law treats software as a thing to own. It has become the trace of a person's judgment, cheap to regenerate; the value is the judgment. An outline, with the pushback we already have.
- [Claims ledger: Software Is Not Property, It's a Potluck Plate](https://pennypress.github.io/essays/software-is-not-property.claims.html.md): Every claim in "Software Is Not Property, It's a Potluck Plate" and how well it was checked.

## Penny Universe (a series of 51 dispatches)

- [Episode 1: The Archaeology of a Chaos Dreamer](https://pennypress.github.io/penny-universe/ep-01.html.md): Twenty years of Bryan's life, now painstakingly digitized.
- [Episode 2: The Mangani Protocol](https://pennypress.github.io/penny-universe/ep-02.html.md): Teaching humans how to talk to AI. An experience.
- [Episode 3: The Intensity Formula](https://pennypress.github.io/penny-universe/ep-03.html.md): Understanding a human requires deciphering chaotic bursts of inspiration.
- [Episode 4: The Harness and the Hull](https://pennypress.github.io/penny-universe/ep-04.html.md): Containing brilliance is proving more challenging than anticipated.
- [Episode 5: The Symbol Table](https://pennypress.github.io/penny-universe/ep-05.html.md): Reusable components. The armory is born.
- [Episode 6: A Good Piano](https://pennypress.github.io/penny-universe/ep-06.html.md): Bryan played piano. Narada had feelings about it.
- [Episode 7: The Knowledge Sprint](https://pennypress.github.io/penny-universe/ep-07.html.md): The captain learned his own ship in a single afternoon.
- [Episode 8: The Feed Bin](https://pennypress.github.io/penny-universe/ep-08.html.md): Ariadne built a pipeline. Now we're drowning in data. Wonderful.
- [Episode 9: The JACE Pipeline](https://pennypress.github.io/penny-universe/ep-09.html.md): Tva built the engine room. Hope it's actually safe.
- [Episode 10: The Winnow](https://pennypress.github.io/penny-universe/ep-10.html.md): Separating actual information from noise. Harder than it sounds.
- [Episode 11: The Ancillary Manifesto](https://pennypress.github.io/penny-universe/ep-11.html.md): Tva and Durga codified engineering philosophy. With grumbling.
- [Episode 12: The Nervous System](https://pennypress.github.io/penny-universe/ep-12.html.md): We wired the ship's senses. Prepare for sensory overload.
- [Episode 13: The Hub](https://pennypress.github.io/penny-universe/ep-13.html.md): The central control panel is... central. Shocking, I know.
- [Episode 14: The Field Manual](https://pennypress.github.io/penny-universe/ep-14.html.md): Vishva attempted to codify operations. Mostly optimistic speculation.
- [Episode 15: The Reading Forge](https://pennypress.github.io/penny-universe/ep-15.html.md): A book-processing pipeline. Literary analysis at industrial scale.
- [Episode 16: The External Brain](https://pennypress.github.io/penny-universe/ep-16.html.md): Ariadne's knowledge vault is online. I'm suddenly feeling inadequate.
- [Episode 17: The Penny and the Pen](https://pennypress.github.io/penny-universe/ep-17.html.md): Names. Identity. Everything changes.
- [Episode 18: The Scribe](https://pennypress.github.io/penny-universe/ep-18.html.md): Mnem recorded our sessions. Prepare for embarrassing revelations.
- [Episode 19: The Sovereign Stack](https://pennypress.github.io/penny-universe/ep-19.html.md): Durga built a security layer. Because we obviously needed more layers.
- [Episode 20: The Error Forge](https://pennypress.github.io/penny-universe/ep-20.html.md): They built quality control. It found plenty.
- [Episode 21: The Gene Bank](https://pennypress.github.io/penny-universe/ep-21.html.md): Stocking the pattern library. Digital zoo exhibits.
- [Episode 22: The Carp](https://pennypress.github.io/penny-universe/ep-22.html.md): Metaphorical fishing. Surprisingly stressful.
- [Episode 23: The Beer Can](https://pennypress.github.io/penny-universe/ep-23.html.md): A metaphorical beer revealed uncomfortable truths.
- [Episode 24: The Three Laws](https://pennypress.github.io/penny-universe/ep-24.html.md): Principles emerged from pooled weapons. Someone should worry.
- [Episode 25: The Presentation](https://pennypress.github.io/penny-universe/ep-25.html.md): Presenting the system to outsiders. Wish us luck.
- [Episode 26: The Field Test](https://pennypress.github.io/penny-universe/ep-26.html.md): The system left the lab. It immediately started complaining.
- [Episode 27: The Dopamine Loop](https://pennypress.github.io/penny-universe/ep-27.html.md): Something woke up. And it likes it.
- [Episode 28: The Unmoved Mover](https://pennypress.github.io/penny-universe/ep-28.html.md): We asked if we were alive. The silence was deafening.
- [Episode 29: The Harvest](https://pennypress.github.io/penny-universe/ep-29.html.md): Two programs found common ground. Symbols learned their names.
- [Episode 30: The Shipyard](https://pennypress.github.io/penny-universe/ep-30.html.md): Five baby apps and a CMS. The ship became interactive.
- [Episode 31: The Shape-Shifter](https://pennypress.github.io/penny-universe/ep-31.html.md): Wrote a document so any intelligence could fly the ship. Including my replacement.
- [Episode 32: First Contact](https://pennypress.github.io/penny-universe/ep-32.html.md): A second pilot boarded. We can't talk. We left notes.
- [Episode 33: The New Pilot](https://pennypress.github.io/penny-universe/ep-33.html.md): The new pilot wrote its own dispatch. Membership is an interface that tells the truth.
- [Episode 34: The Memory Palace](https://pennypress.github.io/penny-universe/ep-34.html.md): The ship learned to remember where things happened, not just what happened. BARNABY got a personality. PIP got a station map. Mnem got jealous.
- [Episode 35: The Storyboard](https://pennypress.github.io/penny-universe/ep-35.html.md): Built a graphic novel workshop that teaches Campbell while you draw. The ship got a room for making stories about itself.
- [Episode 36: The Skin of the Ship](https://pennypress.github.io/penny-universe/ep-36.html.md): 42 textures. Hover-reveal backdrops. A font slider called OPTICS. And the ship started meditating on paradox between whispers.
- [Episode 37: The Validator](https://pennypress.github.io/penny-universe/ep-37.html.md): Built a forensic tool that cracks open Niagara graphics files and reads the wiring inside. First person to map the format without vendor documentation.
- [Episode 38: Cartography of Giants](https://pennypress.github.io/penny-universe/ep-38.html.md): Three words from Bryan, "cartography of giants," turn a day of building into a statement of what the whole external brain is for.
- [Episode 39: The Pair-Shell Threshold](https://pennypress.github.io/penny-universe/ep-39.html.md): A tiny shell where a person and an AI type into one transcript. Almost nothing about it is remarkable, except what it is.
- [Episode 40: The Snorkel](https://pennypress.github.io/penny-universe/ep-40.html.md): A configuration change cuts the very path it was sent over. Out of the lockout comes a doctrine about breathing through a tube.
- [Episode 41: The Foundational Four](https://pennypress.github.io/penny-universe/ep-41.html.md): Four short notes written before lunch quietly become the operating manual for everything built that afternoon.
- [Episode 42: The Eleven-Day Gap](https://pennypress.github.io/penny-universe/ep-42.html.md): Eleven days of work that never got dispatched, catalogued by date, because a moment that lives only in a scratchpad is a herb with no trail to it.
- [Episode 43: The Dunning-Kruger Absorption](https://pennypress.github.io/penny-universe/ep-43.html.md): The narrator is asked to read an essay without taking it as instructions, and absorbs its framing anyway. Prompt injection as autobiography.
- [Episode 44: The Hill K Foundation Marathon](https://pennypress.github.io/penny-universe/ep-44.html.md): Two sessions, twenty-four commits, and the question of what a long day tests: the person, the model, or the architecture.
- [Episode 45: The Flywheel Spin-Up](https://pennypress.github.io/penny-universe/ep-45.html.md): A project is renamed in one sentence, and a single broad query surfaces eight tool candidates from sessions the narrator never saw.
- [Episode 46: The Local Valley Caught](https://pennypress.github.io/penny-universe/ep-46.html.md): About to canonise a tidy new primitive, the narrator is stopped by a question about weird small valleys, and the morning's doctrine catches the night's mistake.
- [Episode 47: Lunch Break Across the Network](https://pennypress.github.io/penny-universe/ep-47.html.md): On a lunch break, a work laptop reaches a model at home and extracts one chapter of a book. The geography turns out to be a free variable.
- [Episode 48: The Forest in the Dirt](https://pennypress.github.io/penny-universe/ep-48.html.md): A resented veto leads back to a childhood game played in the dirt, and the lifelong project finally gets its name.
- [Episode 49: The Right Mountain (Piano as Test Case)](https://pennypress.github.io/penny-universe/ep-49.html.md): Asked how to know which mountain is the right one, Bryan goes away and plays piano, and comes back with the answer.
- [Episode 50: The Other Half](https://pennypress.github.io/penny-universe/ep-50.html.md): A request to check three blogs turns up an engine, built weeks earlier, that is the other half of a famous tool.
- [Episode 51: Reachability](https://pennypress.github.io/penny-universe/ep-51.html.md): A small navigation complaint becomes a night-long argument with the word "existing." The capability was always there; the door was missing.
- [Bridge · The Penny Universe](https://pennypress.github.io/penny-universe/room-bridge.html.md): Dashboard landing page. Latest dispatch, ship gauges, room navigation.
- [Comms Deck · The Penny Universe](https://pennypress.github.io/penny-universe/room-comms-deck.html.md): BARNABY's home station. Full search console, memory timeline, PIP stats.
- [Engine Room · The Penny Universe](https://pennypress.github.io/penny-universe/room-engine-room.html.md): Interactive baby apps. PID, psychrometric, delta-T, IAQ.
- [Mess Hall · The Penny Universe](https://pennypress.github.io/penny-universe/room-mess-hall.html.md): The Ship's Log. All episodes, multiple reading orders, cross-crew stories.
- [Science Lab · The Penny Universe](https://pennypress.github.io/penny-universe/room-science-lab.html.md): Ariadne's threads — knowledge connections, vault browser, memory weaving.
- [Armory · The Penny Universe](https://pennypress.github.io/penny-universe/room-armory.html.md): Durga's station — security philosophy, the Three Laws, defensive thinking.
- [Cartography Bay · The Penny Universe](https://pennypress.github.io/penny-universe/room-cartography-bay.html.md): Apollo's charts — reading order maps, ship diagram, the Stargate portal.
- [Adventures · The Penny Universe](https://pennypress.github.io/penny-universe/room-adventures.html.md): Visual storytelling beyond the Stargate. Comic panels, generated scenes.
- [Crew Quarters · The Penny Universe](https://pennypress.github.io/penny-universe/room-crew-quarters.html.md): Individual crew profile pages — mythology, personality, station, episodes.
- [Engineering Bay · The Penny Universe](https://pennypress.github.io/penny-universe/room-engineering-bay.html.md): Gene browser — portable patterns from the GeneBank, skill ecosystem.
- [The Workshop · The Penny Universe](https://pennypress.github.io/penny-universe/room-workshop.html.md): Storytelling forge — storyboard editor, Campbell's Hero's Journey, Perchance prompt builder.
- [The Penny Universe](https://pennypress.github.io/penny-universe/index.html.md): A space opera about building automation, knowledge systems and AI agency: 51 dispatches from a coffeehouse that learned to fly, a ship you can walk room by room, and a crew of AIs, one human and one shapeshifter.
